subject: Branch environment scaling & governance plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@catalysthealth.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@catalysthealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Branch environment scaling & governance plan

Hi Alicia / Rajesh —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture a proposed approach for the branch environment expansion you asked about during renewal: adding two isolated VPCs (one prod, one analytics), a dedicated cluster for regional inference, and stricter network segmentation for compliance.

High-level proposal (attached: catalyst-provisioning-outline-v1.pdf):
- Term & commit: extend renewal from 24 -> 36 months with staged capacity top-ups at month 1 and month 12.
- Topology: 2 new VPC environments (prod / analytics) + 1 dedicated cluster (8x A100 equivalent) per environment.
- Isolation: network ACLs, private peering, and optional air-gapped data plane for the analytics cluster.
- Ops: include onboarding runbook, backup cadence, and 30-day SLA for provisioning.

Questions for you to confirm so we can firm numbers:
1) Expected steady-state RPS / tokens/day per branch for the first 6 months?
2) Compliance: do you require full air-gap for analytics or is VPC isolation sufficient?
3) Preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and PO contact.

If you’re comfortable with this direction we’ll circulate a short SOW + a proposed amendment to the contract. I’ve looped in Dev and Marcus to confirm lead times and the topology details.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: catalyst-provisioning-outline-v1.pdf]
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@catalysthealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh.kumar@catalysthealth.com>, procurement@catalysthealth.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Branch environment scaling & governance plan

Thanks Monica — this looks useful. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- For capacity, our initial estimate is ~150k tokens/day per branch, with a spike pattern at end-of-month reporting where tokens could go to ~600k/day for a 48-hour window.
- On isolation: analytics cannot be exposed to any public endpoints; VPC isolation + private peering to our analytics VPC should be sufficient for now, but we may revisit air-gapped later.
- Procurement: looping procurement on PO cadence and any vendor paperwork; they prefer to see an initial SOW and a redlineable amendment.

Can you also confirm the approximate provisioning lead time to get both VPCs and one cluster up (we're planning a late-Jan pilot)?

Appreciate it,
Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Head of Platform Engineering, Catalyst Health
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@catalysthealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Branch environment scaling & governance plan

Alicia — quick technical notes / lead times from infra: 

- Provisioning: standard VPC + routing + peering = ~7 business days once we have CIDRs and peering contacts. Dedicated cluster (8x A100 equiv) cold-provision = ~6-8 weeks due to capacity scheduling; we can often prioritize for renewal deals but would need a firm commit and purchase order to hold headroom.
- Topology suggestion: 1 prod cluster (8x) + 1 analytics cluster (6x, quantized profile) per region for the pilot. Analytics cluster can be smaller (quantized 8-bit) to save costs while preserving throughput for batch workloads.
- Network: we will supply a network-segmentation-options.png showing 2 recommended patterns — private peering + transit gateway or direct connect if you need lower-latency encrypted links.
- Data plane air-gap: requires on-prem or physically segregated nodes — adds 4–6 weeks and an additional compliance gap review.

If you confirm the January pilot window we should lock capacity by mid-December for procurement to issue PO.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: network-segmentation-options.png]

Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Catalyst Health — PO questions for Redwood expansion

Hi Monica —

Procurement here. Before we can issue a PO, we need the following: 
1) Short SOW and a statement of work with milestones (pilot kickoff, production go-live).
2) A draft amendment showing the proposed 36-month term, renewal dates, and amended SKUs for the dedicated clusters.
3) Billing contact and vendor W9/TIN paperwork.
4) Pricing: please confirm unit price per dedicated cluster, any one-time setup fees, and whether there are discounts tied to the 36-month commitment.

We can expedite the PO once the SOW and amendment are in docx format for redlines. Our target is to have a PO submitted by Dec 17 to meet the Jan provisioning window.

Thanks,
Catalyst Health Procurement
procurement@catalysthealth.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@catalysthealth.com>, procurement@catalysthealth.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Branch environment scaling & governance plan

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

Agreement in principle
- Term: 36 months with staged capacity (initial pilot: 1 prod cluster + 1 analytics cluster for two branches).
- Isolation: VPC isolation + private peering for pilot; Catalysts can request air-gap as a follow-up if needed.
- Capacity: pilot sizing per branch = 150k tokens/day steady, spike handling up to 600k/day (well use burst + autoscale policies to absorb spikes).

Deliverables we will send by EOD Monday (Dec 20):
1) Short SOW (attached: sow-branch-env-stub.docx) with pilot milestones and acceptance criteria.
2) Draft amendment with the 36-month term and updated SKUs / pricing.
3) Vendor paperwork + billing contact.

Procurement: please confirm the contact and any specific PO template you require. If procurement can issue a PO by Dec 17 we would have been able to lock cluster lead time; since that slip is now likely we still can prioritize but need PO as soon as possible to secure capacity for the Jan pilot.

Action items and owners
- Monica: circulate SOW + amendment for redline (by Dec 20) — DONE (attached).
- Procurement (Catalyst): confirm PO template & target date for PO submission.
- Dev / Marcus: prepare provisioning checklist and estimate (target: Dec 22).
- Alicia / Rajesh: confirm pilot branch list and CIDR information.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff once procurement confirms PO cadence.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sow-branch-env-stub.docx]
